name: Scrounging
label: Quest

intro: Sigrun Ironhew needs materials to build defenses and other necessities for the camp, and has noticed the ogres nearby carry plenty of scrap metal. Sigrun wants seven pieces of it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It's going to be tough going here if I can't manage to scrounge up some materials to construct some defenses and other necessities. I've noticed that the ogres in the area seem to be well equipped with scrap metal. Maybe the stories of siege engines in the Badlands weren't so far off after all...
Anyways, the Prospector's been getting worried about the state of our little camp, so I'd like to get working soon if I can.
The main ogre camp is at Dustbelch Grotto, a good trek to the west of here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Well, I've made do with what I could, but... It's not much. Have you found any more supplies?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It's a start, friend, and it'll have to do until we hear word from Ironforge or the Explorers' League.
Now, if only I could find some salt somewhere for my quenching barrel...
